capability.title: Contact & Hours
capability.description: Two-column contact block that lists email, phone, and catering channels beside a panel of opening hours with an optional label, note, and link.
useWhen: A page should publish contact channels and opening hours together
Guests need to know when a location is open and how to reach it
avoidWhen: Only opening hours or only contact details are needed
The content is a full support or FAQ section rather than a short contact block
